'''She-Who-Speaks''' was the title given to the chief of a [[Sekct]] hunter-gatherer band. They were typically the strongest and wisest of the band and recited the [[Ancient Words]] during ceremonies. [[She-Who-Speaks (Hissest's tribe)|One such]] She-Who-Speaks encountered a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] when they crash-landed on the Sekct [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]], [[Marca/Legends|Marca]].
